**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 12:21
- [USER] User requested an Excel formula that highlights the highest value and the lowest value.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To highlight the highest value in a range of cells, use the formula: =MAX($A$1:$A$10)=A1
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To highlight the lowest value, use the formula: =MIN($A$1:$A$10)=A1
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should replace $A$1:$A$10 with their desired range of cells.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should replace A1 with the cell they want to apply the formatting to.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The formula will compare the value of A1 to the minimum or maximum value in the specified range.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The cell will be highlighted if it's the lowest or highest value, respectively.
